Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I watched the recent Wedding Diary showreels and the cinematic style is exactly the kind of work that converts Instagram viewers into BDT 50K-2.5L bookings — for 1500+ weddings that portfolio is undeniable.

The gap I see: every enquiry still routes to a phone/WhatsApp number, and the couple comparing you to 3-4 other studios is going to book the one that confirms availability fastest. With 2026-2027 season dates filling up, even a 6-hour reply lag loses a date to a faster studio — and that's unrecoverable, because the date is the inventory.

I built an AI booking agent that lives on your Instagram DMs + your site + WhatsApp. The couple types "is Dec 14 available?" and gets a real answer in seconds, with a deposit link to lock the date. If the date is taken, the agent offers the 3 nearest alternatives from your calendar. You wake up to confirmed bookings, not a queue of DMs.

I've built a working demo using your actual portfolio style — happy to show you in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
